page: Microsoft Azure EC4as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECasv6 family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage. It is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach high-performance remote storage volumes. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance. No GPU accelerators are present on this hardware configuration.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the EC4as_v6 is classified as a memory-optimized instance. This resource density provides a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints relative to compute power, without the overhead of paying for excess vCPUs. Suitable workloads include relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data buffering, and mid-sized enterprise applications.
